caption: U want to know my wish? It's to descend on Delhi like lightening ....
full_text: Two worlds collide, rival nations It's a primitive clash, beating in the crusades Bravely we hope against all foes There is so much at stake Seems our freedom goes against the rules Does the crowd understand? Is it East versus West? Or man against man? Can any nation stand alone?
